name: app-shater-design-system-colour-palette-with-hex-codes-and-figma
title: Shater design system: blue and orange colour ramps with hex codes over a Figma colour-styles panel
whatItIs: A light page with an Arabic 'نظام التصميم' (Design System) heading and intro, a 'نظام الألوان' (Colour System) subhead, two diagonal ramps of nine swatches each (blue #D4E3F7 to #08172B, orange #FCE3CF to #301703) with hex labels, and a cropped Figma panel showing colour variable groups and a gradient tool.
whatItMeans: Rigorous and scalable; naming every shade and showing the Figma source proves the system is built to last.
techniques: Show a colour ramp from light to near-black.
Label every swatch with its hex code.
Include a screenshot of the actual design tool.

vocabulary.definition: A sequence of a colour from light to dark.
A named, reusable design value like a colour or spacing unit.
